defects.detail: The candidate library contains PARITY, MOD3_EQUALS_ONE, BIT2 and BIT4, directly matching the four benchmark-generating mechanisms. This is not held-out-label leakage, but it gives the search an oracle-like vocabulary tailored to the benchmark.

The primary comparator is a raw scalar one-dimensional threshold classifier. It is structurally incapable of representing periodic and bitwise concepts, so large gains do not yet show superiority over strong generic feature learning or tree/kernel baselines.

Every task belongs to the same small hand-designed family represented explicitly by a candidate transform. The result demonstrates feature selection when the correct feature is supplied, not discovery of an unseen representation.
The canary was executed through an exact-source connector harness, not a second implementation or native Node runner.

revisedInterpretation.narrowClaim: The current plumbing can preregister a representation-search experiment, preserve held-out selection discipline, count search overhead and identify a supplied useful representation.
revisedInterpretation.reason: Target-aligned representation vocabulary and weak baseline leave the key discovery claim unresolved.
